label.description: The label, or unknown when you could not settle it.

file.description: The repository path of the responsible file; the string none for a question, where nothing needs to change (that is a finding); null when you could not determine the file (that is not).

what_to_change.description: One or two sentences on what to change in the file; empty when the file is none or null.

evidence.description: What you read that shows it, in a sentence; empty if you read nothing that does.

status.description: found: you read the file and it explains the issue. candidate: your best answer, not settled. out_of_budget: you must stop; the label and file may be unknown.

searched.description: Every search query and every path read, each once. Filled in by the harness from the worker's own calls.

not_searched.description: What you know you did not look at.

calls_used.description: The number of the worker's calls to the course's tools. Filled in by the harness.

could_not_determine.description: What you could not settle; an empty list when nothing.

anyOf.description: An answer: found or candidate names a real label and a file (a path, or none for a question).
No answer: only out_of_budget may leave the label or the file undetermined.
